fusions.name: Sporing Puff
fusions.desc: Puffs a spore that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 50%).

fusions.name: Fruiting Body
fusions.desc: A swelling burst that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Symbiosis
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds, and 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mat
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (15% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
